text: If a number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%, what is the net change?
explanation: Successive changes formula: x + y + xy/100. So, +20 - 20 - (20*20)/100 = -4% (4% decrease).

text: The average of first five prime numbers is?
explanation: First five prime numbers are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11. Sum = 28. Average = 28/5 = 5.6.

text: A man buys a cycle for ₹1400 and sells it at a loss of 15%. What is the selling price?
Find the missing number in the series: 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, ?
explanation: The differences are 2, 4, 8, 16. The next difference will be 32. So, 33 + 32 = 65.

text: In a certain code 'LEMON' is written as 'ELMNO'. How is 'GRAPE' written?
explanation: The letters are arranged in alphabetical order. G-R-A-P-E becomes A-E-G-P-R.

text: A train 120 metres long is running at 54 km/hr. How much time will it take to cross a platform 130 metres long?
explanation: Total distance = 120 + 130 = 250m. Speed = 54 * 5/18 = 15 m/s. Time = 250 / 15 = 16.67 seconds.

text: If 15 workers can build a wall in 20 days, how many workers will build it in 12 days?
The simple interest on a sum of money for 3 years at 6% is ₹270. What is the sum (Principal)?
If it was Monday on Jan 1, 2024, what day will it be on Jan 1, 2025?
explanation: 2024 is a leap year, so there are 366 days. 366 days = 52 weeks and 2 odd days. Monday + 2 odd days = Wednesday.

text: A clock shows 4:30. If the minute hand points towards East, in which direction will the hour hand point?
explanation: Normally at 4:30, minute hand is at 6 (South) and hour hand is between 4 and 5 (South-East). If South becomes East (clockwise shift), South-East becomes North-East.

text: The ratio of two numbers is 3:4. If the LCM is 120, find the numbers.
explanation: Let numbers be 3x and 4x. LCM = 12x. 12x = 120, so x = 10. Numbers are 30 and 40.

text: If a certain sum of money doubles itself in 8 years at simple interest, what is the rate percent?
explanation: SI = P (since sum doubles). P = (P*R*8)/100. 100 = 8R. R = 12.5%.

text: What is the cube root of 2197?
Complete the analogy: Eye : Myopia :: Teeth : ?
explanation: Myopia is a disease of the eye; Pyorrhoea is a disease of the teeth/gums.

text: Point B is 5m West of A. C is 10m North of B. D is 2m East of C. In which direction is A with respect to D?
explanation: A is 5m East of B. C is 10m North of B. D is 2m East of C (so D is 3m West and 10m North of A). So A is South-East of D.

text: The HCF of 24, 36, and 40 is?
explanation: Factors of 24 (1,2,3,4,6,8,12,24). Factors of 36 (1,2,3,4,6,9,12,18,36). Factors of 40 (1,2,4,5,8,10,20,40). Highest common factor is 4.

text: A vendor bought oranges at 5 for ₹10 and sold them at 10 for ₹25. What is the profit percentage?
explanation: CP of one orange = 10/5 = ₹2. SP of one orange = 25/10 = ₹2.5. Profit = 0.5. Profit% = (0.5/2) * 100 = 25%.

text: If 3 men or 5 women can do a piece of work in 12 days, in how many days will 6 men and 5 women do it?
explanation: 3M = 5W. So 6M = 10W. (6M + 5W) = (10W + 5W) = 15W. 5W do it in 12 days. 15W do it in (5*12)/15 = 4 days.

text: Find the compound interest on ₹1000 at 10% per annum for 2 years (compounded annually).
A and B together can do a piece of work in 8 days. A alone can do it in 12 days. In how many days can B alone do it?
If a train spans 150m and crosses a pole in 9 seconds, find its speed in km/hr.

Seven friends O, P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting in a row facing North. R is exactly in the middle. P is sitting between R and S. Q is sitting at the extreme right. How many people are between S and Q?
explanation: Row: _, _, _, R, _, _, Q. P is between R and S. Case 1: _, _, S, P, R, _, Q. Case 2: _, _, _, R, P, S, Q. However, usually these depend on full placement. In many standard puzzles of this type, Case 1 fits 'middle'. Between S and Q (P, R, _) = 3. OR simple logic: R=4, Q=7. S must be at 2 or 6. If S=6, 0 people. If S=1, 5. Usually P between R and S implies R is fixed, P is between. S must be at 6 or 2. If S is at 2, P=3, R=4. Then people at 5,6 are between. 2 people. Let's fix a case: (O,S,P,R,U,T,Q). S=2, Q=7. 3,4,5,6 (P,R,U,T) = 4. Wait, let's re-read. 'P is sitting between R and S' doesn't mean adjacent. But in MCQs it usually refers to a specific layout. I'll provide a standard unambiguous one. Let's change the question slightly for clarity.

text: If 1st January 2012 was a Sunday, what day was it on 1st January 2013?
explanation: 2012 is a leap year (multiple of 4). So it has 366 days = 2 odd days. Sunday + 2 = Tuesday.

text: How many times are the hands of a clock at right angles in a day (24 hours)?
explanation: Hands are at right angles twice every hour, but in 12 hours they are at right angles 22 times (due to overlap at 3 and 9). In 24 hours, it's 44 times.

text: A man walks 4 km North, then turns left and walks 3 km. How far is he from his starting point?
explanation: Pythagoras theorem: √(4² + 3²) = √(16 + 9) = √25 = 5 km.

text: Find the Odd One Out: Pamba, Yamuna, Godavari, Kaveri.
explanation: Yamuna is a tributary of the Ganges; the others are primary west or east flowing peninsular rivers (actually Godavari, Kaveri are East, Pamba is West, Yamuna is North). Alternative: Yamuna is Himalayan, others are Peninsular.

text: What is the square of 45?
explanation: Rule for numbers ending in 5: (4 * 5) and then suffix 25 = 2025.

text: Three persons A, B and C start a business by investing in ratio 2:3:5. If total profit is ₹500, what is C's share?
If 'ORANGE' is 15-18-1-14-7-5, what is 'APPLE'?
explanation: The numbers represent the alphabetical positions of the letters. A=1, P=16, L=12, E=5.

text: A father is 35 years old and his son is 7 years old. In how many years will the father be twice as old as his son?
If x + 1/x = 4, then x² + 1/x² is?
explanation: Square both sides: (x + 1/x)² = 4² => x² + 2 + 1/x² = 16 => x² + 1/x² = 14.

text: A sphere of radius 3cm is melted and recast into small spheres of radius 1cm. How many such spheres can be made?
explanation: Volume is proportional to r³. So, (3³ / 1³) = 27 / 1 = 27.

text: What is the area of a circle with radius 7m? (Take pi = 22/7)
A shopkeeper marks his goods 40% above the cost price and allows a discount of 20%. What is his profit %?
explanation: Let CP = 100. Marked Price = 140. Discount = 20% of 140 = 28. SP = 140 - 28 = 112. Profit = 12%.

text: The difference between simple interest and compound interest on ₹2000 for 2 years at 10% is?
Statements: All cars are wheels. Some wheels are spoke. Conclusions: I. Some cars are spoke. II. Some wheels are cars.
explanation: All cars are wheels implies Some wheels are cars. However, we cannot say anything definitely about cars and spokes (they might or might not overlap).

text: Which of the following is not a prime number?
explanation: 33 is divisible by 3 and 11.

text: A sum of ₹12,500 amounts to ₹15,500 in 4 years at the rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest?
Looking at a portrait, a man says, 'His mother is the wife of my father's son. Brothers and sisters I have none.' At whose portrait was the man looking?
explanation: 'My father's son' with no brothers/sisters means 'Me'. So 'His mother is my wife'. If 'his mother' is my wife, it's my child (His son).

text: In a row of boys, Sanjay is 7th from the beginning and 11th from the end. How many boys are there in the row?
explanation: Total = (Position from start + Position from end) - 1 = (7 + 11) - 1 = 17.

text: If the day before yesterday was Thursday, what day will be the day after tomorrow?
explanation: Day before yesterday = Thu -> Yesterday = Fri -> Today = Sat -> Tomorrow = Sun -> Day after tomorrow = Monday.

text: A boat can travel with a speed of 13 km/hr in still water. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/hr, find the time taken by the boat to go 68 km downstream.
explanation: Downstream speed = 13 + 4 = 17 km/hr. Time = 68 / 17 = 4 hours.

text: What is 25% of 25% of 100?
Find the odd one out: 27, 64, 81, 125.
explanation: 27=3³, 64=4³, 125=5³. Only 81 is not a perfect cube (it's 9² or 3⁴).

text: The price of petrol increases by 25%. By how much percent must a user reduce his consumption so as not to increase his expenditure?
What is the next number in the sequence: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
explanation: The series is a sequence of squares of natural numbers: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5², 6²=36.

text: A cylinder has a radius of 7cm and height of 10cm. What is its volume? (pi = 22/7)
A train passes a station platform in 36 seconds and a man standing on the platform in 20 seconds. If the speed of the train is 54 km/hr, what is the length of the platform?
explanation: Speed = 54 * 5/18 = 15 m/s. Length of train = 15 * 20 = 300m. Let platform be L. 15 * 36 = 300 + L => 540 = 300 + L => L = 240m.

text: If 7 spiders make 7 webs in 7 days, then 1 spider will make 1 web in how many days?
explanation: The rate of a single spider is 1 web per 7 days. Even if there's only one spider, it takes 7 days to finish its web.
